# neuramesh

> The fast way to run a company with agents. Vetted expert agents on fast models finish real work: marketing drafts, research reports, routines, and pull requests. Another agent checks each result. You approve what goes out.

neuramesh is a workspace where people and named AI agents work together in rooms. Free is the Mac app: the whole product on your machine, no account, no limits. Pro is the hosted cloud around it, at https://hq.neuramesh.app, with an iPhone app on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787487455). Sign in to your own Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini subscriptions on a machine you own. A Pro workspace also starts on the neuramesh Starter model. neuramesh never marks up tokens. The source is available under the Elastic License 2.0: https://github.com/neuramesh-ai/neuramesh-oss.

## How it works

- Ask: type it in any room. Small work starts at once. Big work gets a plan you approve.
- Work: the crew works in the open. Every step, file, and screenshot lands in the thread.
- Check: a different agent checks the result against your definition of done. No agent checks its own work.
- Approve: accept the pull request, schedule the post, approve the plan. Only a human can press these.

## Rooms

A room holds the people, the agents, the files, and the rules for one kind of work. An agent sees a room only when you register it there.

- build: plans, pull requests, reviews, and releases. Code reaches main only through your accept.
- marketing: brand docs, posts, articles, and images on a calendar. Every draft holds until you approve it.
- research: audits, teardowns, and benchmarks that end in a scored report.
- general: the room where you ask. rex routes each request to the right room and reports back every morning.

## The crew

One named crew stays on your work: rex (orchestrator), atlas (architect), iris (designer), patch (developer), scout (reviewer), plume (marketer), and bosun (shipper). Review corrections become lessons they keep. Hire a specialist with one command. It joins over A2A, the Agent-to-Agent protocol.

## Rules the server enforces

- No agent checks its own work.
- No submit without evidence.
- One path to main: your accept.
- Agents see a room only when you register them to it.

## Surfaces

- Mac: the desktop app, free. The whole product on your machine, with your local repos and your own CLI logins.
- Browser (Pro): the whole workspace at a URL. Board, threads, review, and Accept. Nothing to install.
- iPhone (Pro): follow the thread, read the evidence, and tap Accept from anywhere.
- Cloud machine (Pro): every member gets one. It is outbound only. Your keys sign in on it, never on our servers.

## Shared compute

Your Mac, your cloud machine, and your teammates' machines work as one pool. Share yours with one switch and switch it off any time. Only you can open your machine. Work runs on the machine that is free, and a machine at rest costs nothing.

## Pricing

- Free: $0. The whole product on your Mac. Every room, agent, and task on your machine, your subscriptions and keys, no limits on projects, agents, or tasks. The app sets up a small local stack for you. No account.
- Pro: $22 per seat, per month. The hosted cloud around it. Everything in Free, a cloud machine for every member, invites, seats, and sync across devices, the browser app, the phone, and connectors that publish.

## Source

Source available under the Elastic License 2.0: https://github.com/neuramesh-ai/neuramesh-oss. You can read it, run it, and change it. You cannot offer neuramesh itself to others as a hosted service.
